speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: Our beaches will be re-opened as clean-up operations are completed.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: What are the total expenses incurred so far for the clean-up of our beaches and coastal waters?

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: Does the Government have an estimate of the losses suffered by our locally based businesses as a result of the pollution to our beaches and coastal waters?

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: So, I do not have the answer for him.
